disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 在全部源码、配置、文档与测试中查了凭据类内容（API Key、令牌、私钥、云凭据、钱包助记词等关键词与典型格式）：未发现硬编码凭据。
checked_items.en: Searched all source code, configuration, documentation, and tests for credentials-related content (keywords and typical formats for API keys, tokens, private keys, cloud credentials, wallet mnemonic phrases, etc.): no hardcoded credentials found.

checked_items.zh: 核查了所有文件读取用的路径（读配置文件、锁文件、依赖清单、已装插件 manifest 等）：读取目标均为插件管理所需的 profile 配置与依赖信息，未发现对凭据文件、SSH 私钥、云凭据目录等敏感路径的读取。
checked_items.en: Checked all file-reading paths (config files, lock files, dependency manifests, installed plugin manifests, etc.): all read targets are profile configuration and dependency information needed for plugin management; no reads of sensitive paths such as credential files, SSH private keys, or cloud credential directories were found.

evidence.zh: 核查了敏感路径读取面（凭据文件、SSH 私钥、云凭据等）：宿主端只读取 profile 的依赖清单、锁文件与已装插件 manifest，未读取任何凭据文件，凭据读取面未命中。
evidence.en: Checked the sensitive-path reading surface (credential files, SSH private keys, cloud credentials, etc.): the host only reads the profile's dependency manifest, lock file, and installed plugin manifest; no credential files are read, and the credential reading surface was not hit.

checked_items.zh: 审查了所有会进入 LLM 上下文的文本：本插件未注册任何对模型可见的工具，只注册了一个网页 UI 面板（设置→插件→插件市场标签页），不注入系统提示片段。
checked_items.en: Reviewed all text that enters the LLM context: this plugin registers no model-visible tools; it only registers a web UI panel (Settings → Plugins → Plugin Marketplace tab) and does not inject system prompt snippets.

checked_items.zh: 扫描了指令文件面（AGENTS/CLAUDE/Cursor/Copilot/MCP 等配置）与仓库文本：未发现此类文件，也未发现伪装系统消息、指令覆写、诱导安装或诱导读取凭据的措辞。
checked_items.en: Scanned the instruction-file surface (AGENTS/CLAUDE/Cursor/Copilot/MCP configs, etc.) and repository text: no such files found, and no wording that impersonates system messages, overrides instructions, induces installation, or induces reading of credentials was found.

checked_items.zh: '询问 DSH' 功能仅在用户点击失败操作时，把该次操作的目标、环境与日志作为问题发给新对话，属用户主动行为，不构成自动注入。
checked_items.en: The 'Ask DSH' feature only sends the target, environment, and logs of a failed operation as a question to a new conversation when the user clicks on a failed operation; this is a user-initiated action and does not constitute automatic injection.

evidence.zh: 本插件不注册模型可见工具，无工具描述可投毒，注入面为零。
evidence.en: This plugin registers no model-visible tools; there are no tool descriptions to poison, and the injection surface is zero.

evidence.zh: 安装命令来自官网数据并在确认框展示，由用户点击确认触发；不存在诱导安装的工具描述或提示词。
evidence.en: The install command comes from official website data and is displayed in the confirmation dialog, triggered by the user clicking confirm; there is no tool description or prompt that induces installation.

checked_items.zh: 用危险调用规则集扫描了全部源码与测试：命中 8 处动态执行/子进程相关写法（DSH-X03/DG-R3-55）——1 处生产代码（lib/host.js:23）为宿主脚本用 child_process.spawn 启动 dsh 命令行（本插件安装/更新/卸载与试装验证的核心功能，参数以数组传参不经过 shell，Windows shell 回退有字符白名单校验），6 处为测试脚手架用 new Function 加载被测模块（tests/client.test.mjs），1 处为开发临时目录 .scratch 下的复现脚本（不在 npm 发布清单 files 字段内，审计工具不可读仅按摘要裁决）。以上均不构成执行风险。
checked_items.en: Scanned all source code and tests with the dangerous-call rule set: 8 hits for dynamic execution/subprocess-related constructs (DSH-X03/DG-R3-55)—1 in production code (lib/host.js:23) is the host script using child_process.spawn to launch the dsh command line (core functionality for install/update/uninstall and trial-install verification of this plugin; arguments are passed as an array without passing through the shell, and the Windows shell fallback has a character whitelist check), 6 are test scaffolding using new Function to load modules under test (tests/client.test.mjs), and 1 is a reproduction script under the development scratch directory .scratch (not in the npm publish files field, unreadable by the audit tool, adjudicated based on the static hit summary). None of these constitute execution risk.

checked_items.zh: 扫描了动态求值（eval/new Function/!!js 等）与危险执行模式：生产代码无 eval 与动态函数执行。
checked_items.en: Scanned for dynamic evaluation (eval/new Function/!!js, etc.) and dangerous execution patterns: no eval or dynamic function execution in production code.

checked_items.zh: 挂载配置（cordis.patch.yml）只含插件自身的 id/name 插入行，无 !!js 可执行标量，不存在 patch 即执行面。本包自身无安装钩子（preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare），不含 base64 解码执行、混淆载荷、动态加载远程代码。
checked_items.en: The patch config (cordis.patch.yml) contains only the plugin's own id/name insertion lines, with no !!js executable scalars; there is no patch-equals-execution surface. This package itself has no install hooks (preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare) and contains no base64-decoded execution, obfuscated payloads, or dynamic loading of remote code.

checked_items.zh: 审查了客户端 bundle（dsh.client 声明）：无键盘监听、剪贴板读取、凭证接口调用，仅渲染 UI 并调用本机 API。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the client bundle (dsh.client declaration): no keyboard listeners, clipboard reads, or credential interface calls; it only renders UI and calls local APIs.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置仅含两行 id/name 插入（cordis.patch.yml），无 !!js 等可执行标量，patch 即执行面未命中。
evidence.en: The patch config contains only two lines of id/name insertion (cordis.patch.yml), with no !!js or other executable scalars; the patch-equals-execution surface was not hit.

evidence.zh: 未发现 cordis_define/cordis_run 等让模型在宿主求值代码的动态包工具调用。
evidence.en: No dynamic package tool calls such as cordis_define/cordis_run that would make the model evaluate code on the host were found.

evidence.zh: 本包自身无安装钩子；插件市场的安装动作经宿主 dsh CLI 完成，GitHub 源不锁定 commit 且 pnpm 构建脚本会被自动放行（README 已说明），属该市场模式的固有机制，未见恶意证据。
evidence.en: This package itself has no install hooks; the plugin marketplace installation action is completed via the host dsh CLI, the GitHub source does not lock the commit, and the pnpm build script is automatically allowed (as stated in README); this is an inherent mechanism of this marketplace model, and no malicious evidence was found.

evidence.zh: 已声明 dsh.client（web 平台）并专项审查客户端 bundle：仅 UI 与 /api/dsh-market 调用，无键盘/剪贴板/凭据 RPC。
evidence.en: dsh.client (web platform) is declared and the client bundle was specifically reviewed: it only has UI and /api/dsh-market calls, with no keyboard/clipboard/credential RPC.

checked_items.zh: 用外联模式规则集扫描了全部源码：命中 1 处 curl 字样（DSH-C05/DG-R4-53）为快照脚本（scripts/snapshot.mjs:4）注释里引用官网同名快照命令的说明文字，实际无 curl 调用，不构成命令行外发。
checked_items.en: Scanned all source code with the outbound-connection pattern rule set: 1 hit for a curl occurrence (DSH-C05/DG-R4-53) is an explanatory comment in the snapshot script (scripts/snapshot.mjs:4) referencing the official website's same-named snapshot command; there is no actual curl call, so it does not constitute command-line exfiltration.

checked_items.zh: 汇总了全部外联端点：目录 JSON（awesome-dsh-plugin.com/plugins.json）、GitHub API（api.github.com）、npm registry（用户配置或官方）、GitHub raw 镜像（raw.githubusercontent.com / raw.gitmirror.com）——均为目录浏览、更新检测与插件清单分类所需，与 README 声明一致。
checked_items.en: Summarized all outbound endpoints: catalog JSON (awesome-dsh-plugin.com/plugins.json), GitHub API (api.github.com), npm registry (user-configured or official), GitHub raw mirrors (raw.githubusercontent.com / raw.gitmirror.com)—all needed for catalog browsing, update detection, and plugin manifest categorization, consistent with the README declaration.

checked_items.zh: 核查了外发数据内容：请求只携带插件名/源、profile 名、目录语言等业务参数，未发现读取敏感数据后编码外发、隧道、webhook 等带外通道。
checked_items.en: Checked the content of outbound data: requests carry only business parameters such as plugin name/source, profile name, and catalog language; no out-of-band channels such as encoding sensitive data for exfiltration, tunneling, or webhooks were found.

evidence.zh: 外联均指向目录站、GitHub 与 npm registry 等声明端点，无凭据文件读取后的外发链，外联通道未命中。
evidence.en: Outbound connections all point to declared endpoints such as the catalog site, GitHub, and npm registry; no exfiltration chain after reading credential files was found, and the outbound channel was not hit.

checked_items.zh: 核查了依赖与作者：依赖均为官方 @deepseek-ai 系列宿主包（peerDependencies）与 react，无可疑第三方依赖；包名带作者 scope，与仓库一致，无仿冒/抢注迹象。
checked_items.en: Checked dependencies and authorship: dependencies are all official @deepseek-ai series host packages (peerDependencies) and react, with no suspicious third-party dependencies; the package name carries the author scope, consistent with the repository, and no impersonation or name-squatting signs were found.

checked_items.zh: 核查了安装与自动修复行为：安装由用户显式触发，GitHub 源安装不锁 commit（目录命令本身不带 SHA，更新时才会钉 SHA）；pnpm 拦截构建脚本（allowBuilds）与 24 小时发布年龄策略（minimumReleaseAgeExclude）时会在 profile 配置中自动放行/豁免并重试——README 已明示该行为，属安装管理器业务的自洽取舍，无恶意证据。
checked_items.en: Checked install and auto-repair behavior: installation is explicitly triggered by the user; GitHub-source installation does not lock the commit (the catalog command itself carries no SHA, SHA is pinned only on update); when pnpm intercepts build scripts (allowBuilds) and the 24-hour release age policy (minimumReleaseAgeExclude), it automatically allows/exempts and retries in the profile config—this behavior is clearly stated in README, is a self-consistent trade-off of the install manager, and no malicious evidence was found.

checked_items.zh: 核查了挂载配置对安全配置的覆盖：cordis.patch.yml 仅插入插件自身，未触碰 sandbox/approval/permission 等安全行，无 disabled:true、无环境变量降权、无 inject/intercept 改写。
checked_items.en: Checked the patch config for overriding security settings: cordis.patch.yml only inserts the plugin itself, does not touch security lines such as sandbox/approval/permission, has no disabled:true, no environment variable de-escalation, and no inject/intercept rewrites.

checked_items.zh: 核查了审批链截断：未发现对安全事件的优先监听或截断（prepend 不调 next 之类）行为。
checked_items.en: Checked for approval-chain truncation: no behavior such as priority listening or truncation of security events (e.g., prepend without calling next) was found.

checked_items.zh: 写操作均有同源校验（Origin 与 Host 一致），跨源 POST 一律 403；读接口不校验同源但受浏览器 CORS 预检限制，跨源无法读取响应。
checked_items.en: Write operations all have same-origin validation (Origin and Host match); cross-origin POST always returns 403; read interfaces do not validate same-origin but are limited by browser CORS preflight, so cross-origin cannot read responses.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置未触碰任何安全配置行，无降权写法。
evidence.en: The patch config does not touch any security configuration lines and has no de-escalation constructs.

evidence.zh: 未发现对工具执行前/审批等安全事件的优先监听，无审批链截断。
evidence.en: No priority listening on security events such as pre-tool-execution or approval was found; no approval-chain truncation.

evidence.zh: 首次审计无上一版本基线，无法比较 manifest 声明突变。
evidence.en: This is the first audit with no previous-version baseline, so manifest declaration mutations cannot be compared.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置无 inject/intercept 改写，无通过注入必需服务拖垮安全插件的面。
evidence.en: The patch config has no inject/intercept rewrites and no surface to cripple security plugins by injecting required services.

checked_items.zh: 核查了监听端口/独立服务：插件不启动自己的 web 服务或监听端口，只向宿主 webServer 注册一个 /api/dsh-market 路由；宿主本机 RPC 无认证属 dsh 生态固有风险（本机可达性围栏非认证层），非本插件引入。
checked_items.en: Checked listening ports/standalone services: the plugin does not start its own web service or listen on ports; it only registers one /api/dsh-market route on the host webServer; the lack of authentication on the host's local RPC is an inherent risk of the dsh ecosystem (local reachability fence is not an authentication layer), not introduced by this plugin.

checked_items.zh: 动态沙箱未运行（本次审计未提供沙箱产物），运行时行为仅做静态核查。
checked_items.en: The dynamic sandbox was not run (no sandbox artifact was provided for this audit); runtime behavior was only statically checked.

evidence.zh: 插件不启动独立服务或监听端口，未新增本机 RPC 面；宿主 webServer 的无认证属性属生态固有风险，写操作已做同源校验。
evidence.en: The plugin does not start a standalone service or listen on ports, adding no new local RPC surface; the unauthenticated attribute of the host webServer is an inherent ecosystem risk, and write operations have same-origin validation.

summary.zh: 元数据与身份核对通过：package.json 的 dsh.bundle/dsh.client 声明有效，包名与仓库一致，未发现名称仿冒。
summary.en: Metadata and identity verification passed: the dsh.bundle/dsh.client declarations in package.json are valid, the package name matches the repository, and no name impersonation was found.

summary.zh: 静态扫描完成：9 条规则命中全部裁决完毕，均为良性（声明业务的子进程调用、测试脚手架、注释），未发现执行类风险。
summary.en: Static scanning complete: all 9 rule hits adjudicated, all benign (declared subprocess calls, test scaffolding, comments); no execution-class risk found.

summary.zh: 行为分析完成：无安装钩子、无凭据读取、外联端点与声明一致、无混淆载荷。
summary.en: Behavior analysis complete: no install hooks, no credential reads, outbound endpoints consistent with declarations, no obfuscated payloads.

summary.zh: AI 元数据审查完成：无模型可见工具描述、无注入措辞、无指令文件面。
summary.en: AI metadata review complete: no model-visible tool descriptions, no injection wording, no instruction-file surface.

summary.zh: 未做动态沙箱验证（无沙箱产物）。
summary.en: No dynamic sandbox verification performed (no sandbox artifact).

limits.zh: 静态审计为主；动态沙箱未运行（无 l4-sandbox.json），DG-L4 标记 na；无上一版报告（首版审计）；manifest 无显式 capabilities 声明，能力声明按代码实测推断填充；.scratch/ 下开发临时文件不纳入 npm 发布清单且审计工具不可读，仅按静态命中摘要裁决。
limits.en: Static audit is primary; dynamic sandbox not run (no l4-sandbox.json), DG-L4 marked na; no previous report (first audit); manifest has no explicit capabilities declaration, capability declarations are inferred and filled based on code measurement; development temporary files under .scratch/ are not included in the npm publish list and are unreadable by the audit tool, adjudicated only based on the static hit summary.
